transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. I’m Dr. [Name]. Can you tell me what’s been going on that brought you in today?

I guess... things at work have been feeling off. Dispatch and compliance, they’ve been watching my route changes through the computer system, and sometimes there are little comments over the radio that feel like they’re about me. People say it’s just normal oversight, but I can tell some of the drivers are reporting on me.
Do you feel that people are spying on you or working against you in some way?

Yeah… kind of. I don’t like saying “spying,” but dispatch and compliance can see when I change routes, and it feels like they’re tracking it more than normal. Then there are these little comments over the radio that seem aimed at me. And some drivers… I think they’re reporting back.
Do you think there's a specific reason why dispatch, compliance, or the other drivers are paying extra attention to you?

I don’t know exactly why. It’s just… the route changes, they can see them in the system, and then the radio comments happen after. It feels like more than normal oversight. Like certain drivers are letting them know what I’m doing.
Do you think they're paying extra attention to you because of something specific about you, like your job role, something you’ve done, or who you are?

I don’t know if it’s because of who I am exactly. It’s more… when I change routes, dispatch and compliance can see it in the system, and then the radio comments start. So it feels like certain drivers are reporting on me, like I’m being singled out for that.
Do you think these comments and the attention you’re getting are meant to harm you or make things difficult for you, or do you think people might just be doing their jobs without any bad intentions?

I mean… maybe they’d say they’re just doing their jobs. But it doesn’t feel that way to me. The route changes show up in the computer, then there are comments on the radio, and certain drivers seem like they’re reporting on me. It feels like they’re making it harder for me, yeah.
Do you feel like dispatch, compliance, and the drivers are working together in some way to monitor or target you specifically?

Yeah… it seems that way to me. I mean, dispatch and compliance can see the route changes in the computer, and then there’ll be these little comments on the radio. And certain drivers… it feels like they’re reporting on me. I know people say it’s just normal oversight, but it feels more directed than that.
Do you think there’s a larger plan or organized effort behind the way you’re being watched or targeted?

I don’t know if I’d call it a larger plan. But… it does feel organized, like dispatch and compliance see the route changes in the computer, then the radio comments start, and certain drivers seem to be reporting on me. Even if people say it’s just normal oversight, it feels like it’s aimed at me.
Do these feelings of being watched or targeted happen only at work, or do you feel this way in other parts of your life too?

Mostly at work. That’s where I notice it… the computer changes, dispatch, compliance, the radio comments. And some drivers, like I said, seem to be reporting on me. Outside of work, I don’t really… I mean, it’s not the same.
Do you feel certain that this is happening, even though others have told you it’s just normal oversight?

I mean… yeah. I know people say it’s just normal oversight, but it doesn’t feel that way to me. Dispatch and compliance can see the route changes, and then the radio comments happen… and certain drivers seem like they’re reporting on me. So… I can tell something’s going on.
Have you ever felt like people were against you or plotting against you in any other parts of your life, like at home or with friends?

Not really with friends or at home. It’s mostly work… dispatch and compliance, the route changes on the computer, the radio comments. And some drivers seem like they’re reporting on me. That’s where I notice it.

Do you think there is any possibility that these route changes and radio comments could just be coincidences or part of regular procedures, or do you feel certain that they are intentionally targeted at you?

I guess people can call it procedure, but… no, it doesn’t feel like coincidence. The route changes show up, then there are those little radio comments, and certain drivers seem to know things. So I feel pretty sure it’s aimed at me.
Outside of work, have you ever had any experiences where you felt people were plotting against you or communicating things about you, even when others didn’t seem to notice it?

Outside of work… not really. I don’t usually notice it at home or with friends. It’s more the dispatch and compliance stuff, the route changes in the system, and then the radio comments. That’s where it feels like people are reporting on me.
Have you ever had thoughts that people not related to your work are watching you, talking about you, or trying to harm you, even when others don't seem to notice it?

Not really outside of work. It’s mostly the dispatch and compliance people… the computer route changes, radio comments, and certain drivers acting like they’re reporting on me. I haven’t noticed it much with other people.
Have you ever had thoughts or beliefs that others are working against you, watching you, or talking about you when you're not at work, even when there's no clear evidence that they are?

Not really when I’m not at work. It’s mostly with dispatch and compliance… the computer route changes, the radio comments, and some drivers acting like they’re reporting back on me. People say it’s just normal oversight, but it doesn’t feel like that.
Have you ever had any thoughts or beliefs that you know might sound strange, but you still feel are true, even if others don’t understand them?

I mean… I know it probably sounds strange. But I do feel like dispatch and compliance are tracking me through the computer, with the route changes and stuff. And then there are little comments on the radio… certain drivers seem like they’re reporting on me. People say it’s just normal oversight, but it doesn’t feel that way to me.
Do you think your employer is using any special or unusual methods—like hidden technology or secret communication—to monitor you that others might not be aware of?

I don’t know about hidden technology exactly… but the computer system, the route changes, the way dispatch and compliance handle it—it feels like they’re tracking me through that. And then little things on the radio, certain drivers… like they’re reporting on me. Others say it’s just oversight, but I can tell it’s more than that.
Do you ever feel like there are hidden messages or meanings in things that other people don’t seem to notice, like in the news, on TV, or in everyday conversations?

Not really with TV or the news. It’s more everyday stuff at work… like the radio comments, or certain drivers saying things that feel like they mean something about me. And the route changes on the computer. People say it’s just normal, but… I don’t know. It feels connected.
Do you feel like things people say over the radio or things that happen at work are meant specifically for you, even if they seem like regular communication to others?

Yeah… sometimes. Like the radio stuff, it sounds regular, but it feels like certain comments are aimed at me. And when my route changes in the computer, it’s like dispatch and compliance are watching it. I know people say that’s just oversight, but… it doesn’t feel that simple.

Do you ever feel like there are things happening that others don’t seem to notice, even when you’re not at work, like people are sending signals or communicating in a way that’s meant for you specifically?

Not really outside of work. It’s mostly tied to the job… the computer route changes, dispatch and compliance, and the radio comments. Certain drivers too, like they’re reporting back. People say it’s normal oversight, but it doesn’t feel that way to me.
Do you ever feel like the things you’re experiencing—like being watched or targeted—are happening in a way that doesn’t make sense to most people or seems impossible, even to you?

I mean… I know it probably sounds like it doesn’t make sense to other people. But to me it’s there. The route changes in the computer, dispatch and compliance watching that, and then certain drivers making little comments like they’re reporting on me. People say it’s just normal oversight, but… it doesn’t feel normal.
